article_blocks.text: Strain Type: 60% Indica / 40% Sativa
Genetics: Runtz × Grease Monkey
Breeder: Exotic Genetix
THC Content: 20–30%
CBD Content: Generally below 1%
Terpene Profile: caryophyllene , limonene , myrcene
Primary Flavors: Sweet candy, citrus, diesel, pine, vanilla
Flowering Time (Indoor): 56–63 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September through early October
Indoor Yield: Heavy
Outdoor Yield: High
Grow Difficulty: Moderate

Slapz sits at the collision point between two very different schools of modern cannabis flavor. Runtz supplies the polished side—sweet fruit, candy, cream, and a bright euphoric character—while Grease Monkey drags the profile toward diesel fumes, skunk, pine, earth, and heavy resin. Exotic Genetix combined the two into a marijuana strain whose playful name gives a reasonably accurate warning about its strength.

The first impression can be colorful and sweet, but the experience gains weight rapidly, eventually producing the hazy physical relaxation inherited from Grease Monkey. Dense flowers, extensive trichome coverage, a complicated sweet-and-gas aroma, and potentially very high THC have made this weed particularly attractive to consumers who enjoy modern dessert genetics but want significantly more pungency and physical force behind them.
Genetics and Lineage

Exotic Genetix created Slapz by crossing a Runtz mother with a Grease Monkey father. Preserved original seed listings identify that parental direction specifically and classify the offspring as an indica-dominant hybrid with a heavy-yielding growth pattern. Refined Genetics, which maintains Slapz clone material, independently records the cultivar as Runtz × Grease Monkey and identifies Exotic Genetix as the breeder.

The family tree becomes substantially more complex one generation back. Runtz descends from Zkittlez and Gelato , giving Slapz access to the sweet fruit, candy, cream, and contemporary California flavor profile that made Runtz internationally popular. Grease Monkey comes from GG4 crossed with Cookies & Cream . Through GG4, the lineage gains Chem- and Diesel-oriented pungency, resin production, and physical heaviness; Cookies & Cream contributes vanilla, nutty sweetness, and additional Cookies-family density. Grease Monkey itself was created by Exotic Genetix and is recognized for combining GG4’s diesel funk with the sweeter character of Cookies & Cream.

That pedigree explains why the finished cultivar cannot be reduced to either “candy strain” or “gas strain.” Its ancestry contains Zkittlez, Gelato, GG4, Girl Scout Cookies , and Starfighter -family genetics, placing several influential branches of modern American marijuana breeding in the same plant. The Runtz side can dominate the sweetness, while Grease Monkey provides enough earth, pine, skunk, and fuel to stop the aroma from becoming one-dimensional.
Effects and Experience

Slapz often begins with a quick cerebral change that feels considerably lighter than the later stages suggest. Mood may rise sharply, conversation becomes easier, and an almost playful sense of euphoria can appear before substantial body weight develops. Creative or sensory activities such as music, movies, gaming, and casual socializing can become unusually immersive during this opening phase. The experience is not necessarily energetic in the classic sativa sense, but it can initially feel mentally animated.

Physical relaxation gradually becomes the dominant feature. The shoulders and limbs begin to feel heavier, urgency fades, and the bright mental high shifts toward a slower, hazier form of contentment. This progression is one reason Slapz can surprise someone encountering it for the first time. The Runtz influence creates an approachable entry, while Grease Monkey eventually supplies much of the heavier impact. Contemporary accounts consistently characterize the cultivar as capable of moving from euphoria into substantial relaxation and sedation.

At stronger doses, couch-lock and sleepiness become realistic possibilities. THC concentrations frequently reach the 20% range and can approach or exceed 30% in highly selected flower, making conservative dosing sensible for inexperienced consumers. Too much high-THC cannabis may cause dry mouth, dry eyes, dizziness, impaired short-term memory, anxiety, or uncomfortable mental intensity.
Medical Benefits

For some medical marijuana consumers, Slapz offers a useful combination of mental uplift and progressively stronger physical relaxation. The euphoric beginning may temporarily make everyday stress or low mood less intrusive, while the later body effect can appeal to people seeking a calmer evening experience. Its tendency to increase appetite is another characteristic sometimes valued by consumers who have difficulty eating.

The heavier second half may also appeal to people using cannabis when physical discomfort or restlessness interferes with relaxation. Because the strain can become strongly sedating at larger amounts, evening use often makes more sense than situations requiring sustained attention or coordination.

Those experiences should not be interpreted as proof that Slapz treats anxiety, insomnia, chronic pain, depression, appetite disorders, or another medical condition. Controlled clinical trials have not established therapeutic effects for this specific cultivar. Medical consumers should pay attention to laboratory results for the actual flower and consider possible interactions with prescription medications or underlying health conditions.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Slapz can smell different depending on which side of the family appears first. Some flower opens with sweet citrus, fruit candy, and creamy notes reminiscent of Runtz. Other batches immediately reveal Grease Monkey’s harsher personality through diesel, earth, pine, skunk, and something almost chemical. Once the buds are broken apart, those two profiles tend to collide, producing a much louder combination of sweet fruit and greasy fuel.

Flavor begins somewhat smoother. Citrus and sweet cream may arrive on the inhale, with fruit candy appearing briefly before spice and earth develop. Diesel becomes increasingly obvious toward the exhale, sometimes accompanied by pine, lavender-like florals, vanilla, or pepper. This transition from sweetness into gas is one of the cultivar’s more recognizable traits.

No single terpene ratio applies to every crop, but modern expressions commonly contain caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene, and sometimes linalool among their more prominent aromatic compounds. Grease Monkey itself frequently expresses caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene, providing a plausible chemical foundation for the spicy, citrus, earthy, and fuel-heavy portion of Slapz. Actual terpene percentages should always be taken from a batch-specific laboratory analysis rather than assumed from the strain name.
Growing Information

Exotic Genetix originally recommended growing Slapz as a multi-topped bush. The reason becomes obvious during vegetative growth: plants tend to branch vigorously and can build a broad canopy rather than relying exclusively on one dominant central cola. Historical seed-stock information classifies the cultivar as a heavy producer and gives a flowering window of approximately 56–63 days.

Modern preserved clone material closely matches those figures. Refined Genetics lists flowering at approximately 56–60 days and describes stretch into flowering as low, suggesting the cultivar is easier to contain vertically than many sativa-influenced hybrids. Mature flowers typically become compact and densely stacked, with swollen calyxes surrounded by heavy trichome coverage. The resinous character inherited from Grease Monkey is especially obvious near harvest, when the buds can take on a greasy, frosted appearance.

Outdoor growers can generally expect maturity around late September or early October where climate permits. Dense cannabis flowers require adequate airflow as harvest approaches, particularly when autumn humidity rises. Production can be substantial, but no trustworthy original breeder figure establishes a universal number of grams per square meter or per outdoor plant. Light intensity, plant size, root volume, phenotype, vegetative time, and environmental stability have too much influence for a single yield figure to be meaningful.
FAQ
What are the genetics of Slapz?

Slapz is Runtz × Grease Monkey, bred by Exotic Genetix. Original seed-stock descriptions identify Runtz as the mother and Grease Monkey as the father. Its extended lineage includes Zkittlez, Gelato, GG4, Cookies & Cream, Girl Scout Cookies, and Starfighter-family genetics.
Is Slapz indica or sativa?

The original Exotic Genetix release is generally classified as an indica-dominant hybrid, with preserved breeder-stock information placing it around 60% indica and 40% sativa. Its effects can feel relatively balanced at first but usually become heavier and more physically relaxing as the experience develops.
How strong is Slapz weed?

Slapz is generally considered a high-potency cannabis strain. Modern flower frequently falls somewhere around 20–30% THC, and selected batches can test higher. Actual strength varies considerably by cultivation and phenotype, so the laboratory analysis for a specific product is more reliable than a fixed strain-wide number.
What does Slapz strain taste like?

Sweet fruit, citrus, and candy from the Runtz side combine with diesel, earth, pine, spice, skunk, and creamy vanilla qualities inherited through Grease Monkey. The inhale can be surprisingly sweet, while the finish often becomes noticeably more pungent and fuel-driven.
How long does Slapz take to flower?

Original breeder-stock information places the harvest window at approximately 56–63 days indoors, or roughly eight to nine weeks. Refined Genetics lists a similar 56–60 day flowering time for its preserved Slapz clone. Outdoor plants generally finish from late September into early October in suitable climates.
Final Thoughts on Slapz

Slapz is a useful example of what happens when modern candy genetics are crossed with something considerably dirtier. Runtz brings fruit, cream, sweetness, and euphoric appeal; Grease Monkey counters with GG4-derived resin, fuel, earth, skunk, and a heavier physical temperament. Exotic Genetix combined those qualities into a cultivar that can smell like candy and diesel at the same time while producing an experience that becomes progressively more relaxing as the high unfolds.

The plant itself reinforces that identity. Strong branching, modest flowering stretch, dense trichome-rich buds, heavy yield potential, and an eight-to-nine-week finish make it more than a flavor-driven marijuana hybrid. For cannabis enthusiasts who enjoy Runtz-family sweetness but want deeper gas, stronger body effects, and a substantial potency ceiling, Slapz remains one of Exotic Genetix’s more memorable combinations.
